|sellprice = 20 |ingredients = {{Name|Hardwood|2}}{{Name|Coconut|1}}{{Name|Iridium Ore|4}} |recipe = [[Desert Trader]] for {{Name|Iridium Bar|10|class=inline}} |qiseasoning = false }} The '''Warp Totem: Desert''' is a [[Warp Totem]] that transports the player to [[The Desert]] by selecting it in inventory and {{key|right-clicking}}. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after purchasing the recipe from the [[Desert Trader]] for 10 [[Iridium Bar]]s. It can also be purchased from the [[Desert Trader]] for 3 [[Omni Geode]]s. ==Destination== {{Map|30|20}} [[File:Warp Totem Desert location.png|400px]] ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus }} ==Bundles== The Warp Totem: Desert is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== The Warp Totem: Desert can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Totem Mask|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== The Warp Totem: Desert is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Trivia== If warping to the desert then returning before [[Pam]] arrives at the [[Bus Stop]], the player will be shown driving the bus. ==History== {{History|1.4|Introduced.}} {{NavboxWarpTotems}} [[Category:Warp Totems]] [[de:Teleport Totem: Wüste]] [[es:Tótem de teletransporte: Desierto]] [[fr:Totem de téléportation : Desert]] [[it:Teletra-Totem: Deserto]] [[ja:ワープトーテム:砂漠]] [[ko:워프 토템: 사막]] [[hu:Teleport totem: Sivatag]] [[pt:Totem de Teletransporte: Deserto]] [[ru:Тотем-телепорт: Пустыня]] [[tr:Işınlanma Totemi: Çöl]] [[zh:传送图腾：沙漠]]
